changes.description: Silent Background Updates: Updates now download and install silently in the background without launching the interactive setup wizard.
Seamless Restart to Update: Added a dedicated 'Restart to Update' button in Settings to automatically restart the application and apply updates seamlessly.
One-Click NSIS Installer: Configured application packaging for streamlined one-click installation and background update execution.
Enhanced Download Progress & Status: Improved real-time feedback and status messaging during background update downloads.
